headline: IMSS Modality 40 puts high pensions on standby, but contribution rates will continue to rise
summary: IMSS changes to Modalidad 40 have put new pension grants on hold, but contributions paid to the institute will keep rising gradually over the next four years.
why: Mexico's IMSS is the country's main social security institute, so changes to contribution schedules affect payroll costs for employers and workers.
original_headline: Modalidad 40 del IMSS pone en stand by altas pensiones, pero cuotas de cotización seguirán al alza
